rows.jp: 放送部の合宿だった。
rows.en: It was the Broadcasting Club’s retreat.

ghs.en: It was the Broadcast Club Training Camp.

rows.jp: 俺たち一年生が進級し、幸せな三年生が引退して。
rows.en: We first-years had moved up a year, and the happy third-years had retired.

ghs.en:
Among us the freshmen are being promoted,
while the happy third years are retiring.
ghs.assessment: The source narrates the first-years advancing a grade and the third-years retiring as linked completed transitions. "Among us the freshmen are being promoted" is ungrammatical and changes the sequence to present progressive actions.
ghs.remedy: Use "We first-years moved up a grade, and the happy third-years retired.".

highlights.text:
Among us the freshmen are being promoted,
while the happy third years are retiring.

rows.jp: 新しい一年生が入ってきて。
rows.en: New first-years had joined us.

ghs.en: New freshmen have joined.

rows.jp: 新たな面子は七人で。
rows.en: The new group numbered seven.

ghs.en: A fresh line-up of seven faces.

rows.jp: でも本当は八人で。
rows.en: But really, there were eight.

ghs.en: But actually there were eight.

rows.jp: ７／８ならまあＯＫか、と俺は思っていた。
rows.en: 7/8 was good enough, I had thought.

ghs.en: 7/8, well, we should be OK, I thought.

rows.jp: 彼女は……どうせ呼べばすぐにやってくる。
rows.en: If we called her…… she would come at once anyway.

ghs.en: Her... after all, she'll turn up quick if called.
ghs.assessment: The source's topic is "she": if called, she will come right away anyway. "Her" uses the object form as the subject, and "turn up quick" is grammatically nonstandard here.
ghs.remedy: Use "She... would come right away if we called her, anyway.".

highlights.text: Her... after all, she'll turn up quick if called.

rows.jp: ７人集めるのに。
rows.en: Gathering the seven―――

ghs.en: For this gathering of seven,

rows.jp: 支払った代価は安くない。
rows.en: Had cost us dearly.

ghs.en: there was no cheap price to pay.
ghs.assessment: The source says the price paid to gather seven people was not small. "There was no cheap price to pay" is an unnatural negative construction that fails to state clearly that a steep price was actually paid.
ghs.remedy: Use "the price we paid was not small.".

highlights.text: there was no cheap price to pay.

rows.jp: そりゃもう大騒ぎさ。
rows.en: It had been quite a commotion.

ghs.en: That is, it was already an uproar.
ghs.assessment: そりゃもう emphatically introduces the scale of the commotion. "That is, it was already" misreads the idiomatic discourse phrase as explanatory and temporal wording.
ghs.remedy: Use "It caused one hell of a commotion.".

highlights.text: That is, it was already an uproar.

rows.jp: 一因として、教員が参加しなかったことがある。
rows.en: One reason was that no teachers had taken part.

ghs.en:
One of the causes was how there was
no teaching staff participating.

rows.jp: なぜならこれプライベートな部活動だったからだ。
rows.en: Because this was a private club retreat.

ghs.en:
Because these club activities
are intended to be private,

rows.jp: 学院には内緒のオチャメ。
rows.en: A little bit of mischief kept secret from the academy.

ghs.en: a mischief kept away from the Institute.
ghs.assessment: The source calls it a bit of mischief kept secret from the academy. "A mischief kept away from the Institute" changes secrecy into physical separation and uses an unnatural count noun.
ghs.remedy: Use "a little mischief kept secret from the academy.".

highlights.text: a mischief kept away from the Institute.

rows.jp: 公になれば、ちょっとした騒ぎになる。
rows.en: If word got out, it would cause a bit of a scandal.

ghs.en:
If this was turned public, it
would become quite the uproar.
ghs.assessment: The source says that if it became public, it would cause a minor commotion. "If this was turned public" is ungrammatical and imposes an external passive agent not present in the source.
ghs.remedy: Use "If it became public, it would cause a bit of a commotion.".

highlights.text:
If this was turned public, it
would become quite the uproar.

rows.jp: けど平気だと思った。
rows.en: But I thought we would be fine.

ghs.en: But I thought we'd be alright.

rows.jp: そうして、合宿が終わり。
rows.en: And then the retreat ended.

ghs.en: Finally, the Training Camp is ending.
ghs.assessment: The source says "and so the training camp ended." "Is ending" changes the completed event to an ongoing one, and "Finally" adds a culmination marker not present in the sentence.
ghs.remedy: Use "And so the training camp ended.".

highlights.text: Finally, the Training Camp is ending.

rows.jp: 七人は帰路に着いた。
rows.en: The seven of us started home.

ghs.en: Seven people reached the way of return.
ghs.assessment: 帰路に着いた means the seven set out on the journey home. "Reached the way of return" is an unidiomatic literal construction and can imply that they arrived at a road rather than departed.
ghs.remedy: Use "The seven of us set out for home.".

highlights.text: Seven people reached the way of return.

rows.jp: 途中で日が暮れた。
rows.en: The sun set on the way.

ghs.en: En route, the day grew darker.

rows.jp: ひどく長い時間、歩いていた気がする。
rows.en: It felt as though we had been walking for an awfully long time.

ghs.en: There was this feeling of having walked for horribly long hours.

rows.jp: 何時間も。
rows.en: For hours.

ghs.en: A countless number of hours.
ghs.assessment: 何時間も means many hours or hours on end. "A countless number of hours" exaggerates the duration into something literally innumerable.

rows.jp: 普段は一時間もかからない道だ。
rows.en: Ordinarily, the walk took less than an hour.

ghs.en: On a path that ordinarily never takes more than an hour.

rows.jp: 疲労のせいか。
rows.en: Perhaps it was due to fatigue.

ghs.en: Was it fatigue?

rows.jp: 誰も何も言わなかった。
rows.en: No one said a word.

ghs.en: No one said even one word.

rows.jp: 七つの足音だけの世界だった。
rows.en: It was a world of seven sets of footsteps.

ghs.en: The sound of seven pairs of footsteps was the entire world.

rows.jp: 異様に静かな山道。
rows.en: An unnaturally quiet mountain road.

ghs.en: An unnaturally quiet mountain trail.

rows.jp: 虫の音さえも耳に届かない。
rows.en: Not even the sound of insects reached my ears.

ghs.en: Not even the sound of insects reaches the ears.

rows.jp: 空気までも冷たく感じさせる。
rows.en: It made even the air seem cold.

ghs.en: A chilling sensation made by the mood alone,
ghs.assessment: The source says the eerie quiet made even the air feel cold. The English replaces the air with a generic "chilling sensation" produced by mood alone, removing the concrete sensory image.
ghs.remedy: Use "It made even the air feel cold,".

highlights.text: A chilling sensation made by the mood alone,

rows.jp: 夏だというのに。
rows.en: Though it was summer.

ghs.en: when however it is Summer.
ghs.assessment: The source supplies a concessive fragment: despite it being summer. "When however it is Summer" is ungrammatical and uses a temporal connector instead of a clean concessive relation.

rows.jp: 暗くても、見えたから。
rows.en: Because even in the dark, I could see.

ghs.en: Because I could see, even if it was dark.

rows.jp: 道が見えたから。
rows.en: Because I could see the road.

ghs.en: Because I could see the way.

rows.jp: 俺は昔から夜目がきいた。
rows.en: I had always been able to see well at night.

ghs.en: For a long time now I have been capable of seeing through the dark.

rows.jp: 道を間違えたのかなと思い出した頃、町に出た。
rows.en: Just as I began to wonder if we had taken a wrong turn, we emerged into town.

ghs.en: At the time when thoughts turned to wondering if we had gone the wrong way, we turned up in town.

rows.jp: 人類は滅亡していた。
rows.en: Humanity was extinct.

ghs.en: Mankind had fallen.
ghs.assessment: 滅亡していた states that humanity had become extinct. "Had fallen" can mean defeat or decline and does not communicate extinction.
